author: atomlabor
description: Your Home Assistant on e-ink: a hero card with your key values, lights and switches as tiles you tap to toggle, what is playing on Spotify with cover and controls, all sensors at a glance, refreshed live every 30 seconds while the app is open. Set it up right on the device: sign in with your Home Assistant user name (only a sign-in key is kept, never the password), paste a token or drop a homeassistant.txt into the app folder. The lock screen shows a large clock, up to six values you choose what is playing and the lights that are on; while locked it uses the network every 5 minutes.
